import html # Example template; adjust placeholders as needed. FORUM_POST_FORMAT = """

{header}

{body}
    {options}
""" def construct_forum_content(heading: str, content: str, choices: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct a safe, formatted forum post. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title or subject line of the forum post. content : str The main body text of the forum post. choices : list[str] A list of discussion options or points, provided in markdown. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string containing the formatted forum post. """ # Sanitize all user input to prevent XSS safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Convert each choice into a list item; escape each choice safe_choices = [] for choice in choices: escaped_choice = html.escape(choice, quote=True) safe_choices.append(f"
  • {escaped_choice}
    • ") # Join the list items into a single string options_html = "\n".join(safe_choices) # Format the final post using the template formatted_post = FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( header=safe_heading, body=safe_content, options=options_html ) return formatted_post.strip()
